summary: Keep the pipeline this id names open: its application is still there. A pipeline not renewed for its `keep_s` lapses, and a lapse closes it as a close would - its models come off and the card goes back - so an application that died leaves the card to the next one. A pipeline with `keep_s` 0 needs no renewing; renewing it changes nothing. Renewing writes nothing to the record. The answer is the pipeline as it stands. Refused `not_open` when the id names no open pipeline here - it was closed, it lapsed, or it was never this server's - and the error says which.
